title: The legend
reading: The milk running joke is the spine and the skiing is what happens around it. Opens on the title-drop - 'I became the milkman today, we created a legend' - with no context, then rewinds to the trip and earns it back.
revision: v2 - Karl's note: open on the legend line rather than 'that goes so fucking hard', which moves to the final act. Dialogue segments widened toward the 2-3 min brief; boundaries then snapped to conversational closure by edl_snap.py.

segments.why: 'It's been a long day... I became the milkman today. We created a legend.' - lands on the title drop before we know what it means
airport bar, faces and laughter - 'look at these silly guys doing their little program thing'
'Spencer, welcome' / 'what's up pal' / 'you didn't give me a beer' - the group assembling
airport walkway with luggage
plane - 'you need to put that away' / 'I'm consulting right now' / 'they don't understand', running under the safety PA
night arrival at the van - 'he's on a journey to the porcelain throne' / 'you gotta get one of those action ones'
ridge traverse - establishes the mountain
the jug enters the film - 'How's your milk, Spenny?' through 'you got paparazzi'
carrying it onto the chairlift - 'He's so milked, that's it'
the carve past camera - best pure ski shot; only window without the red pole across frame
'Whoo' at 1.2s then the jump at 3.0s
POV following them down the groomer; avoids the glove over the lens at 0-2s and ~20s
second rider passes close to the lens
'I'm milked out. He's milked out.'
POV run through the trees
the run ends on the jug held up - 'He's got the milk' / 'yeah, high five'
chugging it - 'Jesus Christ' / 'It's Jesus Boris'
'it's so much more than I thought it would be' / 'that's fucking unreal' / 'that goes so fucking hard' - top-ranked audio candidate in the bin
'it's 100% gone bad' / 'alright Spenny, you can do it' / 'oh, this is so nasty'
lounging in the chairs - ends quiet
